subject: general
question: Sutirtha Mukherjee is an Indian ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**table tennis player.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Sutirtha Mukherjee is an Indian table tennis player from West Bengal.**
 
• **She has won the national Table Tennis Championship and also was just a part of the Gold medal-winning Indian women's team at the 2018 Commonwealth Games. **
 
• She had qualified to represent India at the 2020 Summer Olympics.
 
• **Sutirtha Mukherjee won the 2017 and 2020 National Championships.**
